sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:17

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:17:1
items.html:
The aforementioned Ibur needed to be delayed and postponed for a period of twelve months: The level of Malchut, which is the most restricted Katnut possible, is called by the name Ibur, which is from the language of Evra [wrath] and judgments, in the secret of the verse, “And the Lord was wroth with me for your sakes.” Yet one must understand here that these are three Sefirot in thickness, in the secret of the three lines that are called NHY, for less than this measure is not called a Partzuf, as the ARI writes (Etz Chaim, Gate 30, Discourse 2), in the secret of the verse, “And behold a well in the field, and three flocks of sheep lying by it,” which are NHY. See there. For although the whole level is but a single Sefira of Malchut, nevertheless, since there is there the correction of the lines, there are in it three phases: right, left and middle, and these three phases in the level of Malchut are called Netzah, Hod, Yesod. We therefore discern them as being in thickness, one beside the other, to indicate that although there are three Sefirot there, they do not enlarge the level of Malchut in any way, and all three are in the level of a single Sefira. Remember this.
And the matter of the months of Ibur means the renewals of illumination that the Partzuf brings out and reveals in the course of the state of the phases of Ibur, which are seven months, or nine months, or twelve months, for every renewal of illumination is called by the name a month. And here the ARI says that this Ibur includes twelve months, so as to reveal twelve Partzufim, as written further along.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:17:2
items.html:
And the reason is in order to correct all of Atzilut, which are twelve phases: That is to say, through the aforementioned raising of MAN to the secret of the forehead, which is the aspect of the Bina of Keter, where ten Sefirot came out in the level of Malchut, called by the name Ibur, as above in the adjacent item — this Ibur must correct all of Atzilut together, to the very end. And since they are twelve phases, they therefore require twelve months.
And the reason for this is that all the phases whatsoever that were diminished and fell and were broken at the time of the breaking of the vessels of Nekudim rose all together as MAN for this Ibur, as in the words of the ARI above (page 599, item 2), that they include all the Partzufim of the world of Atzilut and of BYA, all of them (see above, page 601, the passage beginning “And although”). For all four posteriors of the upper AVI and of YESHSUT, which are included in the expansion of the three lines of KHB, returned and were gathered above, as above (page 599, the passage beginning “It returned,” see there); and likewise the seven lights of the records that remained from the seven Kings that fell into BYA. And the four posteriors of AVI and YESHSUT include all the Partzufim of the GAR that came out in Atzilut, while the seven lights include the ZON of the four worlds, Atzilut and BYA. Thus all the worlds are included in the MAN that rose to the coupling in Keter, and therefore they must all be corrected through this coupling of Ibur.
And you already know that there is an inverse relation between the lights and the vessels: in the vessels the upper ones grow first, while in the lights it is the opposite, and the lower ones clothe first. Therefore the level of Ibur, which is called NHY, is found clothing in the vessels of KHB. And thus, through the aforementioned general coupling, all twelve Partzufim came out in the aspect of Ibur, one beneath the other: first the KHB of Atik and his Nukva, and afterwards the KHB of Arich and his Nukva, and afterwards the KHB of AVI, and afterwards the KHB of YESHSUT, and afterwards the KHB of ZON, and afterwards the KHB of Yaakov and Leah. All of these came out through the one upper coupling, except that they came one beneath the other according to the order of the degree.
